Just in time for the spooky holiday, HBO has released a surprise episode of “ It: Welcome to Derry ” on the streaming platform. Titled “A Story of Derry,” the special comes in at 30 minutes and is set hundreds of years before the show’s events and the introduction of Pennywise.
The timing is perfect for a surprise release of the supernatural horror, which HBO renewed for a second season in August. “It: Welcome to Derry” originally premiered on HBO Max on Oct. 26, 2025. It is based on Stephen King’s novel “It” and builds on the two-part “It” film reboot from 2017 and 2019. The show serves as a prequel to the films. That month, before the show’s official renewal was announced, co-creator Andy Muschietti told Variety that the writers’ room had opened for Season 2. “There’s gonna be a lot of that depression-era hustling in the air in our characters. Everybody’s trying to get by and survive the circumstances. They are gonna do crazy things,” Muschietti said. “And of course, the social, cultural, horrible things that were happening in the era, too. We’re not going to skip those. [They are the] very center and the heart of our story.”
He also clarified that Season 2 will have a different aesthetic than Season 1.
“In this case, on the surface, Derry is a graveyard almost. It’s a carcass of something because people are depleted, poor, tired, jobless, homeless. The kids don’t have a suburban, comforting life,” Muschietti said. “They’re in a very different situation. Some of them are orphans or runaways, and so the environment is pretty bleak. But there’s always the aspect of hope that is always there, burning, and it’s what keeps our new group going.”
Season 1 is set in 1962 in the fictional town of Derry, Maine, and details the town’s residents’ earlier experiences with the evil, shape-shifting clown, Pennywise. Season 2 will do back in time to 1935 and takes place during the Great Depression. Per the logline, the story “centers on the bloody massacre of the Bradley Gang, a group of bank robbers who stop in Derry to buy ammo and end up facing unimaginable horror.” (The Bradley Gang Massacre is one of the interludes in King’s original novel.)

## हॉरर प्रेमियों के लिए विशेष एपिसोड

हैलोवीन के अवसर पर, स्ट्रीमिंग प्लेटफॉर्म HBO Max ने 'It: Welcome to Derry' का एक विशेष सरप्राइज एपिसोड जारी किया है। इस विशेष एपिसोड का शीर्षक 'A Story of Derry' रखा गया है। यह 30 मिनट का एपिसोड है जो मुख्य श्रृंखला की घटनाओं और 'पेनीवाइज' (Pennywise) के आगमन से सैकड़ों वर्ष पहले की कहानी को दर्शाता है।

## श्रृंखला और आगामी सीजन के बारे में

'It: Welcome to Derry' श्रृंखला स्टीफन किंग के प्रसिद्ध उपन्यास 'It' पर आधारित है और यह 2017 और 2019 में आई फिल्मों का प्रीक्वल है। अगस्त में, HBO ने आधिकारिक तौर पर इस शो के दूसरे सीजन की घोषणा की थी।

श्रृंखला के सह-निर्माता एंडी मुशिएटी (Andy Muschietti) के अनुसार, दूसरे सीजन की कहानी में काफी बदलाव देखने को मिलेंगे:

* **कालखंड:** दूसरा सीजन 1935 के दौर यानी 'ग्रेट डिप्रेशन' (Great Depression) के समय पर केंद्रित होगा।
* **विषय-वस्तु:** कहानी मुख्य रूप से 'ब्रैडली गैंग' (Bradley Gang) के नरसंहार पर आधारित है, जो बैंक लुटेरों का एक समूह था और डेरी (Derry) शहर में भयावह परिस्थितियों का सामना करता है।
* **वातावरण:** मुशिएटी ने बताया कि सीजन 2 का सौंदर्यबोध सीजन 1 से अलग होगा, जिसमें डिप्रेशन के युग की कठोर वास्तविकताएं दिखाई देंगी।

## कैसे देखें और पुष्टि करें

यह एपिसोड अब HBO Max पर उपलब्ध है। दर्शक इसे प्लेटफॉर्म पर सीधे जाकर देख सकते हैं। शो से जुड़ी अधिक आधिकारिक जानकारी और अपडेट्स के लिए दर्शक HBO की वेबसाइट या आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया चैनलों को देख सकते हैं। यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि आप सही सामग्री देख रहे हैं, आधिकारिक स्ट्रीमिंग लिंक और प्लेटफॉर्म की पुष्टि करना हमेशा उचित रहता है।

## Surprise Holiday Release
In a move timed for the Halloween season, HBO has launched a surprise episode of its supernatural horror series, "It: Welcome to Derry." The special, titled "A Story of Derry," is a 30-minute episode that explores the town’s history well before the arrival of the entity known as Pennywise.

## Context and Background
"It: Welcome to Derry" originally debuted on HBO Max in October 2025. The series acts as a prequel to the "It" film reboots released in 2017 and 2019, which were based on the Stephen King novel of the same name. While the first season was set in 1962, the show has already been renewed for a second season, which is expected to shift the timeline significantly.

### Anticipated Developments for Season 2:
* **Setting:** The upcoming season will shift to 1935, during the Great Depression.
* **Plot Focus:** The narrative will reportedly focus on the "Bradley Gang Massacre," an event detailed in Stephen King’s original novel concerning bank robbers encountering supernatural horrors in Derry.
* **Tone:** Co-creator Andy Muschietti has indicated that the aesthetic will be "bleak," reflecting the economic hardships and social struggles of the era, while maintaining themes of hope.

## Verification
Viewers interested in the special can verify its availability by checking the "It: Welcome to Derry" landing page on the Max streaming platform. Details regarding the show’s production updates and future seasons can be corroborated through official HBO press releases and promotional announcements.
